Verified: every empty row shares this grade and an empty track; a sample of themes with multiple recurring rows carry varying transfer_check wording (different verification modes -- track/document/verify/confirm -- applied to the same generic action) but the same underlying action, so one description per theme is correct regardless of which row it lands on. track/code/level stay as they were (LB-<n> codes, level derived structurally by light_fill()).
